# JSM Integrated Services
> PSARA-licensed private security agency and integrated facility management company headquartered in Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu, India.

## What we do
- Security guarding: Ex-Servicemen (ESM) and private security supervisors/guards, PSARA Act 2005 compliant, 2-hour guard relief SLA.
- Manpower staffing: contract industrial and corporate workforce, 100% EPF/ESIC statutory compliance.
- Facility management: commercial and industrial housekeeping, 5-step closed-loop hygiene protocol.

## Service area
Tiruchirappalli (HQ), Chennai, Coimbatore, Hosur, Salem, Erode, Madurai, Tirunelveli — Tamil Nadu, India.
